propositions: Module docstrings across _commands, _cli, _engine_support, _io still reference deleted bash dispatcher (ticket_txn.py, *.sh files) and obsolete Tier E cutover milestones; ~126 lines of confirmed stale narration.

Six individually-identified stale comments document artifacts or behaviors that no longer exist: non-existent shims (txn.py, _engine_support/__init__), false location rationale (reads.py), contradictory import sequencing (_io/__init__), truncated clauses (_cli/_help.py), and in-file-defined functions mislabeled as 'child tickets' (leaf.py).
reads_cli.py contains five near-identical blocks that enforce an unknown-option rule; consolidation into a shared _reject_unknown_option helper recovers lines without behavior change.

No recorded decision rule existed for distinguishing CORRECT-IN-PLACE vs DELETE; disposition framework (parent 373f labels with recorded reason per deletion) established to prevent loss of live-invariant documentation.
